subject: Orphaned supplier account blocking PO acceptance — assistance requested
body:
--- Begin message thread ---

From: Ethan Rogers <ethan.rogers@procurelogic.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: Anna Li <anna.li@procurelogic.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier portal account looks orphaned — PO 6789 acceptance failing

Hi Karthik,

We hit a hard stop on PO 6789 — our buyer says the PO was sent and the "Accept" link in Coupa returns a page saying the supplier account is not linked to our company (shows a blank profile). We tried logging in via SSO and also via the one-time invite link; both show that the supplier profile is missing bank/payment details and the portal shows no linked POs.

I've attached a screenshot of the error (screenshot_po-error-6789.png) and our completed W9 (ProcureLogic_W9.pdf).

Can your team check whether the invite landed on the wrong tenant or whether the account got created as an orphan (new account without tenant mapping)? This is blocking payment and the buyer is asking for timeline.

Thanks,

Ethan Rogers
Senior Procurement Analyst
ProcureLogic


On Tue, Sep 1, 2026 at 09:45, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai wrote:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Ethan Rogers <ethan.rogers@procurelogic.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier portal account looks orphaned — PO 6789 acceptance failing

Thanks for the heads up and the attachments, Ethan — looping in Ben and Monica from Onboarding/Support.

Ben — can you confirm whether this looks like a tenant-claim mismatch (invite accepted under a different org alias) or a Coupa account that never completed profile provisioning? If it helps, Ethan says the buyer email is procureops@brighttools.com and the PO number is 6789.

Next steps I propose:
- Ben to triage logs and confirm whether a supplier profile exists server-side
- If orphaned, we rebind the account to ProcureLogic and push a new accept/invite link
- Monica to own the customer communication and provide ETA

Ethan — we'll keep you posted; earliest estimate is 24–48 hours once we confirm root cause.

-Karthik


On Tue, Sep 1, 2026 at 10:08 AM -0700, ben_carter@redwood.ai wrote:
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Ethan Rogers <ethan.rogers@procurelogic.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 10:08:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier portal account looks orphaned — PO 6789 acceptance failing

Quick triage update:

I pulled the onboarding logs for the invite token shown in Ethan's link. The invite completed successfully (ACCEPTED) but the post-accept callback to create the supplier profile failed with a 502 to our supplier-provisioning service at 2026-09-01T09:33:21Z. The user record exists in auth (OIDC) but there is no supplier_profile row in the DB — that matches Ethan's "blank profile" screenshot.

Immediate plan:
1) Re-run provisioning job for that user id with idempotent checks (will create supplier_profile if missing) — low risk
2) If provisioning job encounters the same 502 we will capture the full stack trace and escalate to infra; temporary mitigation will be to reissue a manual invite and complete profile fields via the admin console to unblock PO.

I'll kick off (1) now and report back with the job run id. ETA: 2–6 hours for completion and verification.

-Ben


On Fri, Sep 3, 2026 at 15:48:00 -0700, monica_patel@redwood.ai wrote:
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Ethan Rogers <ethan.rogers@procurelogic.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2026 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier portal account looks orphaned — PO 6789 acceptance failing

Hi Ethan,

Update: Ben re-ran the provisioning job and created the missing supplier_profile (job id: ONB-2026-9427). I manually verified that the profile now shows your company name, W9, and the PO 6789 is visible under "Pending Acceptances." I then issued a fresh accept link — please try the link below in an incognito browser and let me know if you see the "Accept" button and can complete acceptance.

Direct accept link: https://app.coupa.com/supplier/accept?token=rehash-xyz-2026

If that still fails, please reply with a short screen recording or the exact error text and I'll escalate to infra immediately. We will also open ONB-431 in Jira to track the root cause and follow up on a permanent fix to avoid provisioning race conditions.

Apologies for the disruption — we understand this delays payment and will provide confirmation when the acceptance completes.

Regards,

Monica Patel
Onboarding Specialist, Redwood Inference
Support: onboarding@redwood.ai

--- End message thread ---
